name: Mine Merge Mania 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Mine Merge Mania is an addictive clicker game that invites you to embark on an exhilarating mining adventure. As the master of your own mine, you'll start with basic tools like shovels and pickaxes and progressively unlock new horizons by merging tools and upgrading your mining operation.
